C0046.title: Paid Posting and Fake Reviews: Two 'Online Water Army' Operatives Sentenced
C0046.summary: The People's Court of Cangxi County, Sichuan Province, tried an 'online water army' case. Defendants Li and Ge were convicted of illegal business operations for providing paid posting, fake reviews, and other metric-manipulation services.
